2025/06/06 感谢各位朋友们的关注和积极反馈！我们从以下两个方面对本教程进行了更新：

  • 上线国产化《大模型开发全流程》公益教程（含PPT、实验手册和视频），此处特别感谢华为昇腾社区的支持！
  • 在原系列编程实践教程的基础上进行内容更新，并增加了新的主题（数学推理、GUI Agent、大模型对齐、隐写术等）！

🎯 项目动机

《动手学大模型》系列编程实践教程，由上海交通大学《自然语言处理前沿技术》（NIS8021）、《人工智能安全技术》课程（NIS3353）讲义拓展而来（教师：张倬胜），旨在提供大模型相关的入门编程参考。本教程属公益性质、完全免费。通过简单实践，帮助同学们快速入门大模型，更好地开展课程设计或学术研究。

aiSummary.oneLiner: A comprehensive deep dive into the inner workings, fine-tuning, and deployment of Large Language Models.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: Dive-into-llms provides an extensive, open-source educational repository focused on the comprehensive understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs). It demystifies the complex architecture and underlying mechanisms of state-of-the-art models, offering deep technical insights into pre-training, fine-tuning techniques (like LoRA and QLoRA), and efficient inference optimization. The project combines theoretical explanations with practical, hands-on code examples to guide users through the complete lifecycle of LLM development. By bridging the gap between academic research and practical engineering, it enables developers and researchers to build, deploy, and optimize their own models.
keyFeatures: Architectural Deep Dives: Detailed explanations and breakdowns of Transformer architectures and modern LLM variants.
Fine-Tuning Frameworks: Step-by-step guides and code implementations for advanced fine-tuning methods including LoRA, QLoRA, and P-Tuning.
Inference Optimization: Techniques and tools for optimizing model inference, reducing memory footprint, and increasing throughput in production.
Practical Hands-On Code: Provides executable notebooks and scripts to directly apply theoretical knowledge to real-world datasets and models.
Evaluation Methodologies: Details techniques for accurately benchmarking and evaluating model performance across specific domains.

useCases.title: Learning LLM Fundamentals
useCases.description: For students and engineers wanting to deeply understand how modern Large Language Models are structured and trained from scratch.

useCases.title: Custom Model Fine-Tuning
useCases.description: For practitioners needing to adapt powerful base models to specific domain tasks using resource-efficient fine-tuning techniques.

useCases.title: Deploying Models to Production
useCases.description: For MLOps engineers looking to optimize LLM inference for speed and memory efficiency in real-world applications.

useCases.title: Benchmarking Custom Models
useCases.description: For researchers aiming to establish rigorous evaluation pipelines for testing novel model architectures against industry standards.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: This project is tailored for AI researchers, machine learning engineers, and software developers who want to move beyond using LLM APIs.
aiSummary.gettingStarted: Clone the repository and explore the Jupyter notebooks provided in the root directory.
